title: Best part of our Southern Spain trip
text: We were surprised that we had a private tour, just us and our guide Salvador. He was amazing. He knew so much about the area and Christopher Columbus. Our tour was November 1 so some things like museums were closed but Salvador added other stops to make up for it. He was so polite and truly wanted us to have an amazing adventure. Our best day in Spain (and the rest set the bar high).
author: Vacation52931775558
